mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1200) reflects strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns due to reduced corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high CPI index level (CPIAUCSL > 255) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 255.

mechanism_narrative: A high GDP level (GDPC1 > 18900) reflects strong economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 18900.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.
